author: Vox
description:
There might be more mice and rats factory farmed globally than cows. You've probably never heard about it because they're not feeding humans. They're feeding pet snakes.

Vox's Kenny Torrella breaks down one of the biggest sources of animal suffering in the world.

Read his reporting at the link at Vox.com
